decision_level.task: binary attack versus non-attack only where the locked reference taxonomy explicitly aligns
decision_level.probability_metric_gate: Report Brier/ECE only when the evaluated signal is a valid probability for the evaluated unit; native Laya noul from a long-state deciding window is not treated as calibrated document-level probability.
decision_level.uncertain_handling: Report coverage and uncertainty separately; do not silently convert NO_SIGNAL or UNCERTAIN to a class.

workflow_level.optional_valid_metrics: Include existing independent deception-quality or groundedness measures only if their validity and provenance predate this outcome evaluation; do not add a post-outcome LLM judge.

denominators: Report arm-specific attempted cases, evaluable cases, NO_SIGNAL/UNCERTAIN cases, and final accepted cases explicitly for every rate.
historical_120_role: EXPLORATORY_DECISION_V2_SET only; it is not the sole new confirmatory result.
